people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Ahimaaz
people.line: Son of Zadok the priest, a messenger for David

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Son of Abiathar the priest during David's reign

translations.web: Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house; and they said, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?” The woman said to them, “They have gone over the brook of water.” When they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: When Absalom’s servants came to the woman at the house, they asked, “Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan?” “They have crossed over the brook,” she replied. The men searched but did not find them, so they returned to Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And when Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.
translations.asv: And Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house; and they said, Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They are gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.
